nodes.Name: ErrBadPattern
nodes.DocComment: ErrBadPattern indicates a pattern was malformed.

nodes.Name: Match
nodes.DocComment:
Match reports whether name matches the shell file name pattern.
The pattern syntax is:

	pattern:
		{ term }
	term:
		'*'         matches any sequence of non-Separator characters
		'?'         matches any single non-Separator character
		'[' [ '^' ] { character-range } ']'
		            character class (must be non-empty)
		c           matches character c (c != '*', '?', '\\', '[')
		'\\' c      matches character c (except on Windows)

	character-range:
		c           matches character c (c != '\\', '-', ']')
		'\\' c      matches character c (except on Windows)
		lo '-' hi   matches character c for lo <= c <= hi

Path segments in the pattern must be separated by [Separator].

Match requires pattern to match all of name, not just a substring.
The only possible returned error is [ErrBadPattern], when pattern
is malformed.

On Windows, escaping is disabled. Instead, '\\' is treated as
path separator.

nodes.Name: scanChunk
nodes.DocComment:
scanChunk gets the next segment of pattern, which is a non-star string
possibly preceded by a star.

nodes.Name: matchChunk
nodes.DocComment:
matchChunk checks whether chunk matches the beginning of s.
If so, it returns the remainder of s (after the match).
Chunk is all single-character operators: literals, char classes, and ?.

nodes.Name: getEsc
nodes.DocComment: getEsc gets a possibly-escaped character from chunk, for a character class.

nodes.Name: Glob
nodes.DocComment:
Glob returns the names of all files matching pattern or nil
if there is no matching file. The syntax of patterns is the same
as in [Match]. The pattern may describe hierarchical names such as
/usr/*/bin/ed (assuming the [Separator] is '/').

Glob ignores file system errors such as I/O errors reading directories.
The only possible returned error is [ErrBadPattern], when pattern
is malformed.

nodes.Name: cleanGlobPath
nodes.DocComment: cleanGlobPath prepares path for glob matching.

nodes.Name: cleanGlobPathWindows
nodes.DocComment: cleanGlobPathWindows is windows version of cleanGlobPath.

nodes.Name: glob
nodes.DocComment:
glob searches for files matching pattern in the directory dir
and appends them to matches. If the directory cannot be
opened, it returns the existing matches. New matches are
added in lexicographical order.

nodes.Name: hasMeta
nodes.DocComment:
hasMeta reports whether path contains any of the magic characters
recognized by Match.
